text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Thanks to you, I got to have
a nice, relaxing break!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll sleep in, wake up late,
and head to a manga cafe in the afternoon...♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For dinner, I got to try the new dish at that diner with the amazing simmered food,
and I even painted a wonderful picture tonight!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Look, I think putting in all that time
really made the drawing turn out well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Kiseki happily showed me
her latest illustration.
I'm glad she seemed to have enjoyed her break.
